Training & Mentorship

Training that builds lasting capability

Alongside consulting, NexoIQ helps teams become self-sufficient — through practical workshops, in-company training and one-to-one mentorship.

Request team training

Programmes

Two training tracks

Data Engineering & Databricks

Hands-on training and 1:1 coaching in Apache Spark, Databricks, advanced SQL and modern data architecture.

  • Databricks & PySpark fundamentals
  • Data quality & pipeline orchestration
  • From raw data to analytics-ready tables
  • Practical enterprise use cases
  • Power BI & DAX for data teams

Odoo & ERP adoption

An ERP only works when people understand it. Key users and managers learn the flows they use every day.

  • Odoo for key users & managers
  • Understanding the ERP flow: CRM → sales → stock → invoice
  • Test scenarios & user guides
  • Go-live support

Formats

How training is delivered

In-company workshops

Team sessions on your own data and use cases — on-site in the Netherlands or remote.

1:1 mentorship

Regular coaching for engineers growing into data engineering or Databricks roles.

Remote sessions

Live online training in English, Arabic or Dutch.

Have a data or ERP challenge?

Tell us what you are working on. You will get a straight answer on whether and how NexoIQ can help.
